name: Christel Marioni
headline: VP Commercial Partnerships
about:
With over 10 years’ experience working for different software companies, my comprehensive commercial, strategic and operational expertise has been focused on enhancing customer experience and deploying innovative strategies within the iGaming and financial services sectors.
Through these experiences I have developed a detailed understanding of the customer lifecycle and regulatory frameworks in the gaming sector within major EU countries as well as the key requirements for a successful digital transformation. 

Specialities: 
- Gambling and Financial Services sectors
- Effective Networking, Consultative selling to create key accounts, New Business Development
- Critical key account management, Account Retention and Development
- Commercial Negotiations, Cross-selling, up-selling and gaining referrals
- B2B Marketing, Event Management

… more

experiences.description:
Commercial relationship
• Identify and engage with new partners, from NDA to contract negotiation and signature in line with organisation's strategic goals.
• Commercial Account Management of key partners: overview and coordination of all ongoing projects (technical, marketing, BD etc), and Contract owner: renewals, terminations, Amendments...

New markets
• Help to maintain up to date ‘watch lists’ of potential new markets; including regulatory updates, market studies and potential partnership discussions
• Collaborate with the PMO team to follow through to market launches
• Set up all partnerships and commercials for new market launches

New Product Verticals
• Working with various internal teams to consider viable new product verticals; identifying potential partners and building business cases 

Mergers and Acquisitions
• Work with the Chief Executive, Finance, Legal and Head of Business Development to identify, qualify and manage M&A opportunities.

What people think I do:
• Sell software

What I really do:
• Help Gaming & E-Commerce businesses increase revenue, improve UX, tackle fraud and be ahead of their competition by using Jumio’s cutting edge innovative technology


How does it work:
• Netswipe: By plugging in Jumio’s Netswipe into your customer journey, your customers can scan their credit/debit cards, data is inputted automatically and transaction can be completed within just seconds as opposed to error prone manual input. Result: higher conversions, better UX
• Netverify/Fastfill: Merchants can digitally ID&V their customers by verifying their ID documents almost instantly. Users can both verify themselves and use the extracted data to auto-fill registration and check-out forms. Result: reduced fraud, higher conversions, better UX

•	Drive relationships and communications between merchants/partners and Ukash
•	Initiate and manage contract negotiations and follow through to full integration and successful launch
•	Identify and build innovative marketing strategies to increase clients’ revenues
•	Work with distribution, marketing, compliance and operations to maximize growth and build partnerships across different countries
•	Regularly meet with key account representatives and represent Ukash at industry events

Specialities: Betting & Gaming

Account Management:
